body.statement: Let \(H=V_{\ell+1}\), choose any \(s_h\in B_h\), let \(c\in V_\ell\) be nonparentless and outside every pure block, and take \(C\subseteq H\) with \(k=|C|\). If the baseline and augmented measured endpoint pairs belong to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\), then \(\rho_\ell(S_C,T_C(c))=k\) and \(\rho_\ell(S_C\cup\{c\},T_C(c))=k\) when \(\operatorname{Pa}_G(c)\subseteq C\), whereas the augmented rank is \(k+1\) otherwise. Hence \(N_c(C)=1\) if and only if \(\operatorname{Pa}_G(c)\subseteq C\), independently of representative choices.
body.justification: The exact \(k\)-versus-\(k+1\) increment turns mixed-child parent recovery into monotone deletion.
body.gap: The anchor tests parent subsets and all representative selections; it does not state one-representative neutrality, representative invariance, or deletion-order independence.
body.consumer: One test per candidate parent recovers arbitrary-indegree mixed-child parent sets.
